title: Registration & Welcome Coffee
description: Collect your conference badge and programme booklet from the registration desk in the main foyer.

title: Opening Keynote: Reimagining Higher Education for the 21st Century
description: Professor Nkosi delivers the opening address exploring how emerging technologies are fundamentally reshaping the learning landscape in modern universities, with reflections on institutional readiness and student equity.

title: Morning Tea & Networking
description: Light refreshments served in the exhibition foyer. Poster presentations open.

title: Designing for Inclusion: Universal Design for Learning in Large Lecture Halls
description: This session presents findings from a multi-year UDL implementation study across engineering and health sciences faculties. Practical frameworks and student feedback data are shared.

title: AI-Assisted Feedback in Technical Courses: A Pilot Study
description: A report on using AI-based tools to provide instant formative feedback to students. Results show noticeable improvement in assignment scores.

title: Modernizing the Curriculum: Social Science Case Studies
description: Faculty teams share their experiences redesigning undergraduate syllabi. Includes discussion of institutional adoption and student responses.

title: Flipped Classroom Evidence: What Does the Data Show?
description: A meta-analysis of flipped classroom studies conducted across higher education institutions. The presenter challenges popular assumptions with empirical data.

title: Building an AI Literacy Framework for Non-Technical Students
description: How do we prepare humanities and social science students to navigate an AI-mediated world? This session presents a competency framework piloted across three faculties.

title: Writing for Publication: Getting Your Research Into Journals
description: An intensive hands-on workshop covering academic writing structure, journal selection strategies, and responding to reviewer comments.

title: Lunch Break
description: Lunch served in the main dining hall. Poster session continues in foyer.

title: Student Voices: What Do Learners Need from Technology?
description: A panel of students from different faculties discuss their experience with digital learning tools and hybrid attendance.

title: Day 2 Keynote: Ethical Considerations in Educational Technology
description: Exploring governance, data privacy, and ethical guidelines when implementing automated technologies in educational systems.

title: Interactive Workshop: Building Blended Learning Environments
description: A hands-on workshop covering curriculum mapping, hybrid delivery models, and active learning strategies.

title: Day 3 Keynote: Global Trends in Academic Leadership & Engagement
description: Strategies for fostering interdisciplinary collaboration, community engagement, and institutional growth.

title: Closing Ceremony & Awards Presentation
description: Official closing remarks and presentation of best presentation awards.
